authoring: hand-traced official plan and completed July 2023 photographs; site-specific Blender MCP construction

georeference.method: four corresponding official-plan core points and named OSM source polygon centroids, affine fit; each final tower separately recentred on its source centroid
georeference.limitations: OSM polygons are not survey control; plan perspective/diagram and source geometry differ. Local dimensions and offsets remain unsurveyed.

buildings.heightBasis: B/D use OSM 199m recorded height; A/C reduced by estimated 3m per differing official storey. Height includes illustrative crown. No measured as-built heights.
buildings.floorsBasis: official dated 2022-06-17 dong/unit chart, source OSM all65 superseded
buildings.floorplanAccuracy: Manual diagram trace; OSM-centroid anchored, not cadastral or architectural measurement.
